title: Decision trees
description: Greedy impurity-based splitting (Gini, entropy, squared error), leaf predictions, overfitting and pruning.

title: Bagging and random forests
description: Bootstrap aggregation, decorrelating trees with random feature subsets, variance of an average and out-of-bag error.

title: Boosting and gradient boosting
description: Stagewise additive models, AdaBoost from exponential loss, gradient descent in function space, shrinkage.

title: Support vector machines
description: Maximum margin, soft margin and hinge loss, Lagrangian dual, support vectors and kernels.

title: k-nearest neighbours
description: Instance-based classification and regression, choice of k, feature scaling, curse of dimensionality.

title: Naive Bayes
description: Generative classification with conditional independence, multinomial and Gaussian variants, Laplace smoothing.
